tagline: CareTrust REIT is a self-administered, publicly-traded REIT engaged in the ownership, acquisition, financing, development and leasing of skilled nursing, senior housing and other healthcare-related properties.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the hero because it represents the primary rental revenue stream generated by the healthcare property portfolio, reflecting real estate portfolio growth and the operational performance of leased properties.

kpis.name: Total Rental Income
kpis.explanation: Total rental income generated by the leased healthcare property portfolio.
kpis.description: Total rental income is the primary revenue stream for CareTrust REIT, generated through leasing healthcare properties under triple-net leases.
kpis.signal: Primary revenue driver for a healthcare real estate REIT.

kpis.name: Contractual Rent Collections
kpis.explanation: Percentage of contractual rents and interest collected.
kpis.description: Percentage of contractual rents and interest collected during the year, reflecting tenants' ability to meet their financial obligations.
kpis.signal: Stability of rental revenues despite macroeconomic challenges.

kpis.name: Properties and Operating Units
kpis.explanation: Total number of properties and operating units in the portfolio.
kpis.description: Total number of beds and operational units across 407 healthcare properties located in 32 states and the United Kingdom.
kpis.signal: Size and reach of the healthcare real estate portfolio.

kpis.name: Number of Properties
kpis.explanation: Total number of healthcare properties owned or controlled.
kpis.description: Total number of skilled nursing facilities, senior housing and other healthcare-related properties owned directly or indirectly through consolidated joint ventures.
kpis.signal: Geographic and operational diversification of the portfolio.

kpis.name: Care REIT Acquisition Amount
kpis.explanation: Total cash amount paid to shareholders for the acquisition of Care REIT plc.
kpis.description: Acquisition completed in May 2025 of Care REIT plc for approximately $595.4 million in cash plus assumption of $290.9 million in liabilities, including the acquisition of assets from Impact Health Partners LLP.
kpis.signal: Major strategic acquisition to strengthen the international portfolio.

kpis.name: SHOP Communities Acquired
kpis.explanation: Number of senior housing communities acquired under the SHOP platform using the RIDEA structure.
kpis.description: Three senior housing communities comprising 270 units in Texas acquired in December 2025, marking the initial use of the RIDEA structure for the SHOP platform.
kpis.signal: Strategic diversification into direct operation of healthcare properties.

kpis.name: SHOP Operating Units
kpis.explanation: Number of operating units in SHOP communities held through consolidated joint ventures.
kpis.description: Operating units in the three senior housing communities held indirectly through consolidated joint ventures and operated under the SHOP platform.
kpis.signal: Growth in capacity under the new SHOP operating platform.

kpis.short: Other Real Estate Investments Carrying Value
kpis.name: Other Real Estate Investments Carrying Value
kpis.explanation: Carrying value of investments in preferred equity, mortgage loans and mezzanine loans.
kpis.description: Carrying value of four preferred equity investments, 16 mortgage loans and five mezzanine loans, reflecting diversification of healthcare-related real estate investments.
kpis.signal: Diversification of revenue sources beyond triple-net leases.

kpis.name: SHOP Platform Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Three senior housing communities acquired as part of establishing the SHOP platform.
kpis.description: The acquisition of three senior housing communities in December 2025 marks the initial use of the RIDEA structure for the new SHOP operating platform, representing a strategic diversification beyond triple-net leases.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into direct operation of senior housing properties.

kpis.name: Care REIT plc Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Care REIT plc and assets of Impact Health Partners LLP.
kpis.description: Acquisition completed on May 8, 2025, of Care REIT plc for approximately $595.4 million in cash plus assumption of $290.9 million in liabilities. Transaction also included the acquisition of assets from Impact Health Partners LLP on June 30, 2025, for $6.8 million.
kpis.signal: Transformative acquisition to expand the international portfolio and presence in the United Kingdom.

kpis.name: Contractual Rent Collections
kpis.explanation: Percentage of contractual rents and interest collected during the year.
kpis.description: Collection of 99.7 percent of contractual rents and interest due from operators and borrowers during 2025, excluding properties held as assets held for sale and sold during the period.
kpis.signal: Resilient stability of rental revenues despite macroeconomic pressures.

risks.title: Tenant and Borrower Dependence
risks.score_rationale: This risk is identified as the first risk factor and repeated throughout the document (page 26+). The intensity of language is high ('materially and adversely affect'). Dependence is structural due to the majority of properties operated under triple-net leases. Ensign represents 23 percent of annualized rental revenues, creating significant concentration.

risks.title: Tenant or Borrower Bankruptcy Risk
risks.score_rationale: Bankruptcy risk is explicitly mentioned as a direct consequence of tenant dependence. Language uses 'material adverse effect' and 'recover substantially less than the full value'. The context shows this is a structural and recurring risk for healthcare REITs.

risks.title: Concentration of Dependence on Ensign
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically detailed (page 26) with precise figures showing Ensign represents 23 percent of annualized rental revenues. Ensign's inability to meet obligations is described as 'materially adversely affect'. This significant concentration justifies high severity.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Volatility and Inflation
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A explicitly describes current macroeconomic challenges ('market uncertainty', 'inflation', 'elevated interest rates', 'declining consumer sentiment'). Impact on operators is direct ('adversely impacted our tenants ability to meet some of their financial obligations'). These conditions directly affect tenants' ability to generate revenue and pay rents.

ai_positioning.summary: CareTrust REIT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The company is a healthcare real estate REIT focused on leasing skilled nursing and senior housing properties.
